decision: POST /accounts/<id>/sms reads `to` and `from`; the message text goes under msg, message, text and content in one request until a confirmed send shows which name is read
why: Probed with sentinel recipients (nothing sent): flat and nested `body`/`from_number`/`to_number` all came back all-blank; `to`+`from` parsed. CTM reference is a JS app we cannot fetch, so the text name is unconfirmed

decision: One POST per send, no retries; a timeout or 5xx is `unknown` and blocks the same text until someone checks `texts`
why: Sending twice to a real person is the one irreversible mistake here; mirrors kayako-filer never retry a send

decision: Bulk scheduled campaigns stay a browser workflow; the connector covers single texts and lookups only
why: ctm-bulk-sms skill documents the Scheduled texts form; no bulk API route is confirmed
